seventh alpha of mihawkos, the homebrew title that runs windows games on a ps5 from a desktop of their own mihawk os. it is still experimental at a glance what s new big games get twice the room. a 64-bit game now runs inside mihawkos itself, with a page-table pool of 16,384 instead of 8,192: the limit that made large games crash or close one file to install. the windows runtime ships inside the ppsa99170 folder. no usb drive, no second download: mihawkos installs and updates its runtime by itself a new main menu. a tile grid on a sky, a file browser that starts any program, options for each game, an on-screen keyboard, and ten languages in this release games inside mihawkos install and updates the main menu games and graphics steam payloads and logs played on the console known limits installing or updating source and credits games inside mihawkos twice the page tables. a 64-bit game runs inside the mihawkos title instead of in a separate helper, so it gets the title s pool of 16,384 page tables instead of the helpers 8,192. steam, launchers, installers and web-based programs keep running the old way only real games go inside. a program that draws with directx or opengl is treated as a game; launchers installers, crash reporters, web-technology games nw.js, electron and .net tools run the old way a crashed or frozen game returns you to mihawkos instead of hanging the console. a game that shows no new picture for 3 minutes is closed, and the log records what it was waiting for message boxes are visible. an error or message box from a game inside mihawkos is shown on screen, and cross answers it. before, it was invisible and the game looked frozen heavy games no longer freeze the whole console : games inside mihawkos run at a lower cpu priority than the console s own work your choice, per game: press triangle on a game for its options, including run inside mihawkos or the old way install and updates one folder. the runtime is inside ppsa99170 runtime-pieces runtime: it wrote only the 18 files that changed 75.8 mb in 12.9 seconds, and all 2,565 runtime files then matched the new package. the final build updated over the one before it the same way automatic update check. mihawkos asks github for the list of releases, sends nothing about you or your console and accepts only updates signed with mihawkos s own key. to turn it off: settings, aero tile grid on a sky. mihawk os and steam have their own tiles; your games follow page by page l1 r1 . move with the d-pad, or with the hand pointer on the left stick files. browse your windows drive c: from the main menu and press cross on any program to start it, without opening the mihawk os desktop. files only looks: nothing is changed or deleted options for each game triangle : game mode, controller, and where it runs on-screen keyboard. off by default. turn it on in settings, controls, and choose how to open it during a game a two-finger touchpad click, l3 r3, or options touchpad click. checked on a ps5 pro: it opens, and its keys type into a game inside mihawkos and into a program running the old way ten languages for the main menu and settings, including the 30 themes. they follow the language you chose in setup. game, file and steam names are never translated bubble city by the artist skeuoss is the new wallpaper, on the mihawk os desktop and the ps5 home screen used with their permission the your browser companion tile shows the qr code for the web ui. steam has its own icon, settings has a cog, and the button hints are centred games and graphics frames reach the screen sooner. copying each finished frame to the tv went from about 7.4 ms to under 1 ms, so every game has more time for its own work. checked on a ps5 pro with the witcher 3 and with our own test picture directx 12 feature level 12 1 it was 11 1 . games that require 12 0 get past your gpu does not meet the minimum . games that create shared directx 12 resources no longer fail at start games see the real gpu: amd radeon playstation 5 gpu or playstation 5 pro gpu , with the real number of compute units and clock speeds, through directx and amd s ags library more reserved graphics memory pieces: up to 32,768 it was 4,096 , refused only when the console s page tables really run low undertale, deltarune and other gamemaker games start. a small shared section in their program could not be mapped with the ps5 s larger memory pages; it now is deltarune s sound stays clean after switching chapters. a game whose launcher starts a second program now shares one sound clock between them movies shared between directx 9 and directx 11 work when the game creates its directx 11 side first games installed through steam carry their steam app id , so wine s built-in game workarounds apply and steamworks sees the game as started by steam a mod s dll override for example in the web ui s environment field no longer switches off mihawkos s graphics layers a game that loses its controller and gets it back is told so, and finds the controller again a 64-bit game may reserve far more address space some ask for 16 to 256 gib at once , which the console used to refuse fewer crashes in games that use xaudio2 sound; opengl games that set their pixel format twice no longer fail; a start-up deadlock in some programs is fixed; older games cpu checks no longer trip games that place graphics memory over their own memory directx 12 existing heaps , used for example by a forza horizon 2 pc recompilation can now do it inside mihawkos. checked with our own test program on a ps5 pro, not yet with that game a game can read the program that started it , even when that program runs separately the mihawk os desktop for example , and gets the same answers as on windows a program can read another program s command line , as on windows. launchers and web-technology games that check how their own programs were started now get the answer a game that cannot start for example, a missing dll no longer leaves mihawkos stuck: you re back at the launcher, which says last session ended: game.exe could not start: x.dll was not found steam big downloads no longer close steam. a memory-saving feature for steam s web pages took most of the console s file slots, so a download with many files ran out and steam closed. it is capped now, and open files always come first over 10,000 files open at once it was about 8,200 , checked on a ps5 pro: 10,000 files opened, written, read back and closed steam memory warning. before steam installs or starts, mihawkos warns if your ps5 is already using too much memory for steam to work, and lists the steps that fix it. press circle to go back, or hold triangle for 5 seconds to continue anyway steam cloud tip: if cloud saves never download, check the ps5 s own dns settings, network, connection status . a dns server that blocks storage.googleapis.com stops steam s downloads from google s storage while the other providers keep working payloads and logs the payload checklist has a way through. if it doesn t pass, hold triangle for 5 seconds to continue anyway the next start checks again. it no longer blocks when nanodns isn t detected or shadowmountplus s version can t be read, it recognises payload names the ps5 cuts at 19 characters, and qafutkn util mk2 is allowed the payload memory notice appears only when paylo
